This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk

THE Governor of Sabaragamuwa Province has published in the Extraordinary Gazette under the provisions of the Act No. 2316/20 dated 24th January, 2023, “Regulations of the preparation of plans and publication of notice including the list of roads and narrow paths maintained by the Pradeshiya Sabhas in the Sabaragamuwa Province” and for the roads and narrow paths deemed to be owned by the Weligepola Pradeshiya Sabha in the Schedule included in the notification published in the Gazette No. 2422/63 dated 07th February, 2025. It is hereby published for the information to the public that it has been decided under council resolution No. 6.1 (iii) held on 11th September, 2025, Since no case has been filed in the competent court by the date specified in the said notification, all the said roads and narrow paths should be owned by the Weligepola Pradeshiya Sabha.

A list of such roads and narrow paths is included in the Schedule hereto, and each road and narrow path included therein. It is further announced that the roads and narrow paths which have been acquired by the Weligepola Pradeshiya Sabha under Sub-section (5) of Section 24 of the Pradeshiya Sabha Act shall be deemed to be. H. A. Chaminda Dasanayaka, Chairman, Weligepola Pradeshiya Sabha, Hunuwala - Opanayaka. At Weligepola Pradeshiya Sabha,11th September, 2025.
